name: Okaa-san no Ama Ama Time ~Issho ni Yoru no Kenshuu Massage~
original_name: お母さんの甘々タイム ～一緒に夜の研修マッサージ～
source:
The protagonist's father died when he was young, and he was raised by his mother, a nurse, as a single mother. She is kind, cheerful, and has a lovely body. She has been his ideal woman since he was a child. 

He became a doctor because he wanted to be with his mother as much as possible by working at the same hospital. He says, "I'm so happy to be working in the same hospital with you".

However, the protagonist spends his days feeling depressed due to a series of difficult tasks. His mother, worried about him, invites him to her office one day when she is on duty. Lying on the bed, his mother smiles kindly and seductively, telling him that he can gain experience by using her body.

Now, I want you to examine mother's body as much as you want. As if lured by her words, the protagonist reaches out to touch his mother's body.

[From [url=http://highseen.pink/mammami-a/product/mam_pro04.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
主人公幼年父亲去世，由身为护士的母亲以单亲妈妈的身份抚养长大。她善良、开朗，身体也很可爱。她从小就是他理想中的女人。

他成为一名医生是因为他想通过在同一家医院工作来尽可能多地陪伴母亲。他说：“我很高兴能和你在同一家医院工作”。

然而，主人公却因为一系列艰巨的任务而郁郁寡欢。他的母亲担心他，有一天她值班时邀请他到她的办公室。躺在床上，母亲的笑容慈祥而诱人，告诉他可以用自己的身体来获得经验。

现在，我要你尽可能多地检查母亲的身体。仿佛被她的话所吸引，主角伸手触摸母亲的身体。
